evidence_quotes: Valmet and Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) are strengthening their long-standing partnership in India’s transition towards flexible power plant operations.
Together, the companies have secured 31 advanced process control (APC) orders for PC boilers, with 13 systems already commissioned.
